summary: This standards-track RFC describes how to configure proactive MPLS-TP Operations, Administration, and Maintenance functions for a label switched path. It does this using a set of TLVs carried by the LSP Ping protocol.

eli5.summary: Before a road starts its automatic health checks, someone has to say how they should work. This uses ping messages to carry those settings.

questions: configure mpls-tp oam with lsp ping
